references.text: The creation account where God creates the heavens, the earth, the seas, and everything in them over six days.
God finished his work on the seventh day and rested, and he blessed and made holy the seventh day.
The Sabbath as a sign between God and Israel, referring to how the Lord created the heavens and the earth in six days and rested on the seventh.
Parallel formulation of the Sabbath commandment in Deuteronomy.
Nehemiah confesses that God created the heavens, the heaven of heavens with all their host, the earth and everything on it, the seas and everything in them.
By the word of the Lord the heavens were made, and all their host by the breath of his mouth.
The Lord who created the heavens and the earth, the sea and everything in them.
The Lord is an eternal God who has created the ends of the earth.
Prayer to God who created the heavens and the earth and the seas and everything in them.
Paul and Barnabas proclaim the living God who created the heavens and the earth and the seas and everything in them.
Reference to how God rested from all his works on the seventh day.
The angel swears by him who lives forever and ever, who created the heaven and what is in it, the earth and what is on it, the sea and what is in it.
Call to worship him who created the heavens and the earth and the seas and the springs of water.
The historical foundational account of the completion of creation as the basis for the Sabbath message.
The original act of creation that forms the foundation for the institution of the Sabbath.
